t: This item can store several redstone channels ($(5)right click$() on a $(l:rftoolsbase:logic/redstone_transmitter)Redstone Transmitter$(/l) or $(l:rftoolsbase:logic/redstone_receiver)Redstone Receiver$(/l) to add the channel). You can then put it in a $(l:rftoolsbase:tools/tablet)Tablet$(/l) which allows you to examine and change redstone signals from anywhere

此物品可储存多个红石通道（$(5)右键$()点击$(l:rftoolsbase:logic/redstone_transmitter)红石信号发信器$(/l)或$(l:rftoolsbase:logic/redstone_receiver)红石信号接收器$(/l)即可添加通道）。随后可将其放入$(l:rftoolsbase:tools/tablet)平板电脑$(/l)中，从而随时随地查看并修改红石信号。
